items.claim: Two enemies touching the player in one step cost two lives
Falling out of the level is the one hit that doesn't duck the music
A walker placed with no floor under it hangs in mid-air and reverses every step
The left and right walls stop above row 0, so a body above the level can leave it sideways
A jump pressed while the demo is paused (or before Start) fires on resume, however long ago it was
Coins stop spinning when the run is decided, while the rest of the presentation keeps moving
Enabling audio after the flag impact starts the music bed that the impact was meant to cut
Enemy-hit knockback overwritten by the next step
Stomp, spike and enemy knock-ups clipped by the jump cut
advanceWorld keeps stepping after the run is decided
`?`-block bonk costs a life while invulnerable
Spikes play the hurt sequence but cost no life
items.note: This was a behavior call: I made spikes cost a life and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Enemies float 4 units above the floor
Walkers treat only SOLID as wall and floor
Head hit straddling `#` and `?` drops the bonk
enableAudio's deferred setup applies a stale musicOn
Overlapping ducks restore the music early
parseLevel accepts a level with no `S`/`G`, or several
items.note: This was a behavior call: a missing marker throws unless `{ markers: 'optional' }` is passed (the geometry test fixtures use it), and a duplicate always throws. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Jitter readout records a pause in running as jitter
Callouts freeze on screen once the run is decided
Flagpole shake slides instead of shaking
items.note: It's the same fix as the callouts: both now run on a new `g.clock` that `stepEnding` also advances.

items.claim: audioState is a snapshot taken at unlock
items.note: The hook now listens for `statechange` on `engine.context`.

items.claim: Knockback pushed against the player's facing, not away from the enemy
Pending duck restore not cleared on unmount
